Horizontally seamless repeat: matching structures, silhouette heights and colors at left/right edges. No actual brands, no watermark, no frame. Fill extra area with authored architecture, small windows, rooftop antennas, water tanks, cables, RE/X/star motifs. EXACT canvas 960x540. Opaque night city far layer. Same subdued dark navy night and plum clouds, rectangular ruined skyline rhythm, distant two or three flat value planes, sparse dim windows, antenna spires and billboard frames.
